alice: Morning — quick standup for GPU fleet.
alice: What I did: migrated two model queues to the new slot allocator, tuned crew autoscaler thresholds to reduce small-batch churn. Verified metrics pipeline ingests capacity metrics.
alice: Blockers: GCP quota for us-east1 GPUs still at 320, we need 450 by EOD for a canary. I've opened a case but not approved yet.
ben: FYI I submitted a quota increase request earlier: case #1184923. GCP responded: "processing, expect 24-48h". I flagged it as urgent.
ben: Also saw a surge in preemptions last night in us-east1-c — might be noisy neighbor or spot reclaim. Logs show repeated reschedules.
dmitri: We have ~10% spare capacity in eu-west1 and ap-south1 but higher p99 latency. Can divert non-SLA tenants there temporarily.
carol: +1 on diverting non-critical workloads. Need a quick routing policy toggle — I can open a tiny PR to route "non-prod" tag to eu-west1 when us-east1 < 80%.
carol: @alice do you want me to include burst-to-dedicated for the same PR? saves us manual steps.
alice: Yes please, include the dedicated burst path. Keep it gated by feature flag 'region_fallback'.
infra-bot: Provisioning job 9876 started for pool "dedicated-us-east1-g5" (requested by ben).
eva: Pushed PR #2543 for capacity estimation corrections — changed lookback window to 3h and added margin factor. Needs review: @ben @dmitri
ben: Reviewing PR now. One comment: use reserved_capacity metric instead of active_instances to avoid double-counting in short spikes.
dmitri: Agree with ben. Also add a small doc note about the fallback semantics and billing impact.
alice: Blocker update: pushed escalation to our GCP rep, asked for temporary quota grant for the canary. If not approved by 3pm PT, we'll enable eu-west1 fallback for the canary.
alice: Today: monitor the quota response, land PRs for routing + allocator, and smoke test canary in eu-west1 if needed.
carol: I'll open the routing PR in the next 20m and tag reviewers.
ben: I'll finish PR review and follow up on the GCP case. If quota granted, we can reassign workloads back.
dmitri: I'll prepare a quick runbook for failure scenarios (preemption waves / regional outage) and post it here.
alice: Thanks team. If you hit anything urgent ping me and DM infra oncall. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: FYI — provisioning job 9876 reported 3/4 instances healthy, one failed boot with error: "disk not found". Investigating.
carol: Noted — will watch. If disk issue persists we roll that instance out of the pool.
ben: Case #1184923 updated: GCP asked for quota justification details, I've provided traffic projections and cost estimates.
eva: Added tests covering slot allocator edge cases to the PR — small jitter fix included.
alice: Last note: let's avoid mass rebalancing during peak traffic window (13:00-15:00 PT). Schedule heavy ops after 16:00 PT.
carol: Roger that.
ben: Will queue big moves for 16:30 PT.
alice: End of thread."
